name: Joanni Jacobo Clotten — marriage to Maria Magdalena Weber, 30 June 1716
researcher_question: When did Joanni Jacobo Clotten marry the 'Mariae Magdalenae' the tree records as his wife, and what was her surname?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 23, hint-samples.csv row 719, flag adds_marriage, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-09-25 as a TRUE MATCH and corrected 2026-09-28 after review: entry 4 on image ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSJG-4SKS-Y reads, in Latin, "30 Junij — Copulatus est in facie Ecclesiæ honestus viduus Joannes Jacobus Klotten cum virtuosa virgine Maria Magdalena Weber ex Castellaun", in the Boppard Catholic marriage register 1711-1794. An earlier note gave the date as the German "30. Juni 1716"; that is the index’s rendering of the christening records, not the register’s wording. The marriage and both christenings (1:1:D6JH-MXW2, 1:1:W66B-R53Z, 1:1:W66Y-2V6Z) each carry Boppard on their own event fact, so the marriage is in the same parish as the 1717 and 1720 christenings; the Oberwesel in starting-tree.gedcomx.json is an artifact of standardizing the tree’s own place string and is not what the records say. f1’s place was corrected from the collection title ("Rheinland, Bistum Trier") to the event place the record gives ("Boppard, Sankt Goar"). Step 1a image-reading calibration passed on two other indexed entries from the same page. See README "Notes for reviewers".
